content: Timing engine: performance.now() is the high-resolution clock for measuring elapsed time. requestAnimationFrame is ONLY for triggering visual updates, NOT for timing. AudioContext.currentTime provides audio-grade precision but is overkill for subtitle-only playback. Key pattern: record start timestamp on play, compute elapsed = now() - start on each rAF tick, binary search cues for active one. Avoid setTimeout/setInterval for timing - they drift and throttle in background tabs.
